sentences.en: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
sentences.zh: 你最好马上去看家庭医生。

sentences.en: Paul's family spends the summer at the coast every year.
sentences.zh: 保罗一家每年夏天都会去海边度假。

sentences.en: The members of the family nursed the patient by turns.
